note: Declared HS 870899 (auto parts) does not match any observed record: the actual customs lines are 84879000 (grease nipples), 84597020 (tapping machine), 82079090 (nut former tooling), 73181600 (flange nylon nuts) — i.e. fasteners and fastener-making machinery, not motor-vehicle parts of 8708. Per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base with the HS code corrected to the factual fastener codes (73181600 / 84879000) and verdict accepted_hs_corrected.
